summary: The test suite employs a sophisticated three-layer strategy: fast unit tests (BuildMatrix.Tests.ps1) validating cartesian products, include/exclude logic, and validation rules; acceptance tests via GitHub Actions in Docker (Workflow.Tests.ps1) exercising five fixture scenarios end-to-end through act; and workflow structure validation (WorkflowStructure.Tests.ps1) checking actionlint compliance, triggers, permissions, and file references. Coverage is comprehensive—all stated requirements (matrix generation, include/exclude rules, max-parallel, fail-fast, validation, JSON output) are tested. Rigor is thorough: edge cases (empty axes, oversized matrices, partial excludes), error scenarios (file/JSON errors, validation failures), boundary conditions, and exact GitHub documentation compliance are all validated. Design is exemplary: tests are well-organized into logical Describe blocks with clear comments; the single act invocation with fixture-delimited output is elegant and efficient; helper functions are purposeful; and assertions check exact expected values rather than mere presence. The three-layer approach—unit logic, real pipeline execution, and structural validation—provides strong confidence that this test suite will reliably catch regressions across both PowerShell logic and CI/CD integration.
